payload.description_html:
The placement of Zachełmie tetrapod trackways and footprints from early-middle Eifelian on a timeline in relation to some other key Devonian fossils of interest.

Sources:

  • Niedźwiedzki et al., 2010, doi:10.1038/nature08623
  • Swartz, 2012, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0033683
  • Gradstein et al., 2012, doi:10.1016/B978-0-444-59425-9.00004-4
  • Narkiewicz et al., 2015, doi:10.1111/let.12083

Images derived from:

  • Mateus Zica, GFDL (tetrapod outline): File:PleaisaidesZICA.png
  • Nobu Tamura, CC BY-SA 3.0 (body fossils restorations): File:Gogonasus BW.jpg, File:Eusthenopteron BW.jpg, File:Panderichthys BW.jpg, File:Tiktaalik BW.jpg, File:Elginerpeton BW.jpg, File:Acanthostega BW.jpg, File:Ichthyostega BW.jpg
